original_test_intent.statement: Perform 250 AC reboot cycles and verify all required HMC/BMC-visible I2C devices after each cycle.
must_preserve: AC reboot, 250 cycles, I2C polling at HMC/BMC execution location.
unknowns: Meaning/order of AC and DC tokens, actual i2cPoll selector, power waveform and bus/device/alias baseline.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: Correct classification and reason; V3 further protects against host-side i2cdetect substitution and unsafe probing.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Genuine semantic/safety block until WAT owner reconciles mixed AC/DC tokens, proves i2cPoll selection and defines safe HMC/BMC inventory evidence.

revision_candidate.test_name: AC Reboot with HMC/BMC I2C Polling — Scenario Correction Required
revision_candidate.purpose: After owner correction, execute 250 true AC cycles and prove every required management-side I2C device returns without bus or platform faults.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact WAT/HMC/BMC build and approved AC power fixture.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Signed HMC/BMC bus/mux/channel/address/device inventory; host OS I2C is not a substitute.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Authoritative WAT flag ordering/scenario, explicit i2cPoll mapping, AC waveform/dwell, safe read method, expected device/alias/mux baseline, timeouts, recovery and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Read-only package help/inventory only; no cycling or bus probe until corrected scenario. Then run bounded 250 cycles with per-cycle management-side inventory through the vendor-safe interface.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Scenario conflict closed and physical AC/OOB recovery proven.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Signed semantics; package hash; power trace/cycle ledger; per-cycle bus/device identity and errors; BMC/HMC/host/SEL health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: All 250 true AC cycles recover the complete signed management I2C inventory without disallowed bus errors.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not drop `AC`/`DC` tokens by guess, substitute warm/DC reboot, run blind `i2cdetect`, access host instead of HMC/BMC or clear logs.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: WAT/BMC owner and qualified AC operator must approve.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop power sequence, preserve management state, restore safe power and recover BMC/HMC via approved path.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved flags/poll mapping, unsafe probe, missing I2C device, bus stuck, boot/BMC failure or evidence gap.

reason_for_change: I2C polling through management firmware is platform-specific and may disturb buses; an OS scan or guessed removal of scenario tokens would change both the operation and reboot type.
removed_ambiguities: Execution location is HMC/BMC, not host OS.
remaining_blockers: Scenario semantics and safe inventory unresolved.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 keeps the justified BLOCKED status while adding the missing execution-location boundary and banning generic active I2C scanning as fake evidence.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Row 85 title says AC+i2cPoll while command mixes AC and DC and names no i2cPoll token.
